user.title: Set up Clap Sensor (USB Microphone)
user.description: Configures double and triple clap detection via an attached USB microphone (e.g. USB webcam) or via events from the Clap Sensor Add-on.

data.input_device: Audio input device ('default' for default USB mic or 'event_only')
data.snr_threshold_db: Minimum SNR above background/fan noise in dB
data.min_high_freq_ratio: Min. high-frequency ratio 1–4.8 kHz (filters low thuds)
